name: estate-sociology
skills: Sociology of housing estates, from a field study of nine cooperatives over three years: what collective money-raising does to relations between neighbours, who takes part and who stays out (owners and tenants, income groups, newcomers), what breeds suspicion and disputes, and which rules kept trust.
examples: Will a raffle among residents divide our estate?
Why do tenants stay out of our cooperative's fundraising?
Should we publish who bought tickets?
